title: Kenyan Rice Pilaf with Coconut and Onions
description: A flavorful and aromatic rice pilaf dish from Kenya, made with coconut milk and onions, perfect for a date night dinner.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the saucepan and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the curry powder to the saucepan and stir for 1 minute.
Add the rice to the saucepan and stir to coat the rice with the curry powder mixture.
Add the coconut milk to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the saucepan.
Simmer the pilaf for 18-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
While the pilaf is cooking, heat about 1-2 inches of coconut oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add the pumpkin seeds to the pan and deep-fry until they are golden brown.
Remove the pumpkin seeds from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Once the pilaf is done, fluff it with a fork and stir in the fried pumpkin seeds.
Season the pilaf with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional pumpkin seeds if desired.
